name: D20 TEST
description: On a D20 TEST you roll a d20 dice and most of a time add a number to the result which decreases or increases the result which is made against some Difficulty Threshold DT that has to be exceeded.

name: DT
description: The difficulty of any D20 TEST is measured by the Difficulty Threshld ([DT]). The [DT] should be exlusivly based upon the difficulty of the action the actor attempts.

name: ADVANTAGE
description: When you make a D20 TEST you roll the d20 twice and take the better result.

name: DISADVANTAGE
description: When you make a D20 TEST you roll the d20 twice and take the worse result.

name: MARTIAL TEST
description: Tests made when performing Martial Maneuvers. A MARTIAL TEST is a D20 TEST that benefits from your MARTIAL LEVEL and an Attribute that is stated in the context.

name: SPELL CAST TEST
description: Roll 2d6 + SPELL LEVEL and if the roll is lower than the Cast Difficulty of the Spell or double 1s, a magical mishap occurs after the spell was cast

name: SPELL TEST
description: 'SPELL TEST', 'Tests made when casting Spells. A [SPELL TEST] is a [D20 TEST] that benefits from your SPELL LEVEL and an Attribute that is stated in the context

name: CONCENTRATION
description: 'CONCENTRATION', 'Abilities with these keywords need to activly maintained by the caster. They are listed with a number which denotes how much [AP] they need to spend to maintain the ability, if they are not able to spend the [AP] the ability ends.', 'concentration-test

name: CONCENTRATION TEST
description: 'CONCENTRATION TEST', '[SPELL TEST]. A Concentration Test determines if you can maintain focus on a spell while external factors attempt to disrupt it. A [CONCENTRATION TEST] is made by rolling a d20 and adding your Concentration Bonus, which is calculated the following way: [CON] + [SPELL LEVEL]', 'concentration-test

name: SHIELD BLOCK
description: 'SHIELD BLOCK', 'When wielding and hit by an [ATTACK], instead of a [DODGE] [SAVE] make a [SHIELD BLOCK]. Which is a [SAVE] with a bonus of Shield Block + [MARTIAL LEVEL]', 'shield-block

name: EXHAUSTION
description: When characters push themselves beyond their physical limits, they suffer points of [EXHAUSTION] which grant a cumulative -1 penalty to any D20 TEST. If that increases beyond their limit they fall unconcious, if it increases above twice their limit they die.

name: DEATHS DOOR
description: DEATHS DOOR allows you to keep on fighting even when you are reduced to 0 HP, however at risk to yourself.

name: ROUND
description: TODO

name: TURN
description: TODO

name: MELEE
description: Within 1▢ of you, can be modified by your Size and certain abilities

name: SELF
description: You are the ability Target

name: AURA
description: Listed with a radius, effects every creature that is within range of that radius. The effect is applied at the start of the ROUND or the first time they enter but only once per [ROUND].

name: SPHERE
description: Listed with a radius, the center of a sphere needs to be within range of the ability and the center is always in between fields.

name: LINE
description: Listed with a length x width. It starts from the caster of the ability and extends until the lenght.

name: CONE
description: A cone with the listed length starting from the ability caster.

name: AREA EFFECT
description: Describes an ongoing effect in a designated target area that happens to each creature in the area at the start of the [ROUND] or any moves into the area, each creature can only be affected by it once per [ROUND].

name: SAVE ENDS
description: The target can repeat the SAVE at the end of each of the ROUND ending all effects of the ability on a sucess

name: LEVEL
description: Your characters current LEVEL, it increases as your character spends time adventuring and earns XP. When your LEVEL increases your characters statistics also improve in several ways.

name: MARTIAL LEVEL
description: Your Characters MARTIAL LEVEL is calculated by multiplying the Martial Level Progression of your Class with your LEVEL and rounding down.

name: SPELL LEVEL
description: Your Characters SPELL LEVEL is calculated by multiplying the Spellcasting Level Progression of your Class with your LEVEL and rounding down.

name: HP
description: Health Points. Represents how much damage you can take before going unconcious.

name: THP
description: Temporary health points. They are a buffer against damage, a pool of hit points that protect you from injury.

name: STR
description: Strength represents the physical strength of a character, it affects your damage with weapons, carrying capacity and jumping distance.

name: AGI
description: Agility represents how agile, dexterous and fast the character is, it represents accuracy with melee attacks, movement and the ability to dodge incoming attacks.

name: CON
description: Constitution represents our bodily health as well as your endurance and the ability to resist poisons.

name: INT
description: Intelligence represents your Intelligence, it represents how many techniques you can know at the same time and how many skill points you have.

name: SPI
description: Spirit represents how strong your connection to the elemental planes and the Aether is as well your mental fortitude and spiritual health, it most importantly affects your ability to use spells and other supernatural techniques.

name: PER
description: Perception represents your physical senses and the ability to perceive details and weak spots and accuracy of ranged attacks.

name: CHA
description: Charisma represents how likeable you are and your ability to sway others for your cause.

name: MARTIAL DAMAGE
description: The damage you deal with weapon attacks, split into light, one-handed and two-handed damage.

name: STAMINA
description: STAMINA is your energy reserve with which you can replenish your Resources like HP and Aether and is used up when performing physically demanding tasks.

name: ARCANA
description: Your ARCANA represents an energy reserve you expend when drawing power from the elemental planes and the aether to cast spells.

name: STABILITY
description: 'A representation of the characters resistance against being forcefully moved or crushed against their will. Increases with your STR

name: DODGE
description: A representation of how good the character is at evading danger. Increases with your AGI

name: TOUGHNESS
description: A representation of the characters bodily health and ability to resist internal injuries, poisons and concussions. Increases with your CON

name: WILLPOWER
description: A representation of how well the character can resist being mind-controlled, feeling fear or resisting other mind affecting effects. Increases with your SPI

name: DR
description: Damage Resistance provides flat damage reduction against incoming damage against a specific damage type.

name: AP
description: Action Points represent how many things a creature or character can do during a ROUND. Most Abilities require to spend AP to use them. All AP are regained at the start of earch ROUND and are not kept between rounds.

name: MP
description: Movement points. It is a measurement to determine how much someone can move during Combat, one Movement Point is equal to 1▢ (1.5m)

name: FIELD
description: The Environment is split up into ▢(Fields) that are usually squres and 1.5m in length. It is the primary distance measurement unit used in Abilities.

name: REACTION
description: Abilities with the REACTION Tag may be used anytime.

name: SIZE
description: Most humanoids are medium SIZE, however certain species have different ones and certain effects might change your SIZE. Changing your SIZE affects your STR and DODGE

name: XP
description: Experience Points. Experience is accumulated during play by adventuring, defeating Monsters, solving Quests, good role-play and other achievements the Game Master deems worth-wile.

name: HALF
description: After damage calculation only half damage (rounded down) is applied.

name: CRIT
description: Every dice in the damage calculation can be rolled twice and both results are counted for the damage total.

name: SMALL COVER
description: 'SMALL COVER', 'If 25% of creatures visibility is blocked, when being targeted by an [ATTACK] unmodified roll of 1-5 always misses and +2 bonus to [DODGE] and [SHIELD BLOCK]', 'cover'

name: MEDIUM COVER
description: 'MEDIUM COVER', 'If 50% of creatures visibility is blocked, when being targeted by an [ATTACK] unmodified roll of 1-10 always misses and +4 bonus to [DODGE] and [SHIELD BLOCK]', 'cover'

name: LARGE COVER
description: 'LARGE COVER', 'If 75% of creatures visibility is blocked, when being targeted by an [ATTACK] unmodified roll of 1-15 always misses and +6 bonus to [DODGE] and [SHIELD BLOCK]', 'cover'

name: PRONE
description: 'PRONE', 'Lying on the Ground, Move Cost doubled, [DISADVANTAGE] when making a [MELEE ATTACK], [ADVANTAGE] when targeted by a [MELEE ATTACK], always recieving at least [SMALL COVER] against any [RANGED ATTACK]', 'prone'

name: FLANKING
description: 'FLANKING', 'When surrounding a target, recieve a +2 bonus to any [MELEE ATTACK] against Target.', 'flanking'

name: PARTIAL CONCEALMENT
description: 'PARTIAL CONCEALMENT', 'Concealment [DT] = 8 + Stealth Ranks, +5 bonus when making [ATTACK] against unaware target', 'concealment'

name: FULL CONCEALMENT
description: 'FULL CONCEALMENT', 'Concealment [DT] = 15 + Stealth Ranks, +5 bonus or [ADVANTAGE] when making [ATTACK] against unaware target', 'concealment'
